candidates.title: Partial eclipse of Beaver Moon 2021
candidates.description: A nearly total eclipse of November’s full “Beaver Moon” occurs over the city of New Orleans in the early morning hours of Friday, November 19, 2021. The 97% eclipse clocked in at 3 hours, 28 minutes and 24 seconds making it the longest partial moon eclipse in 580 years. Image credit: NASA/Michael De
